ImageAccounting.description:
Per-request accounting in image units.

`output_images` counts what the response carries, not the requested `n`.
The image counts are always present; only `num_inference_steps` can be
omitted, and an unknown step count is omitted, never written as 0. See
[`ImageAccounting::merge`] for how a multi-chunk response treats each field.

input_images.description:
Reference images the request consumed: 0 for text-to-image, 1 for an
`input_reference` or an `/v1/images/edits` request.

num_inference_steps.description:
The step count the backend ran. Omitted when the backend does not
know it.

ImageBackground.description: Requested background of the generated images

ImageData.description: One generated image. The worker sets one of `url` and `b64_json`.

url.description: URL of the generated image (if response_format is "url")

revised_prompt.description: The prompt the model used, when it rewrote the original prompt

ImageNvExt.description: NVIDIA extensions to the OpenAI Images API

annotations.description:
Annotations
User requests triggers which result in the request issue back out-of-band information in the SSE
stream using the `event:` field.

negative_prompt.description: A text description of the undesired image(s).

num_inference_steps.description: The number of denoising steps, at least 1. More denoising steps usually lead to a higher quality image at the expense of slower inference.

guidance_scale.description: The CFG scale. Higher values usually lead to more coherent images.

seed.description:
The seed for the random number generator.
i64 to match PyTorch's torch.manual_seed() accepted range.

ImageOutputFormat.description: File format of the generated images

ImageReferences.description:
The wire shape of [`NvCreateImageRequest::input_reference`]: one
reference as a string, two or more as an array. The field itself is a
list, which is what a worker reads. One reference goes out as a string
so a worker whose model has the string field of an earlier release keeps
reading it. An empty array and a blank reference are rejected, and the
error does not repeat the references.

ImageResponseBackground.description: Actual background of the generated images

ImageTokenDetails.description: A token count split by kind.

ImageUsage.description:
Token usage of an image generation. Keeps the wire format of the OpenAI
`ImageGenUsage`, including the singular `output_token_details`.

input_tokens.description: Tokens (image and text) in the input prompt

total_tokens.description: Tokens (image and text) used for the generation

ImagesResponseNvExt.description:
NVIDIA extensions to the OpenAI Images API response. Omitted from the
wire when the worker reports nothing.

oneOf.description: Image-based accounting for models that have no token usage.

MediaDelivery.description:
Delivery mode of generated media: a URL to the file, or the bytes as
base64 text.

The set has two values. A request with an unknown value fails to parse.

NvCreateImageRequest.description:
Request for image generation (/v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits).

The OpenAI fields keep the wire format of the OpenAI `CreateImageRequest`;
the module documentation says why they are declared here and not wrapped.
`model` and `size` are free text, because the OpenAI type accepts any
string there.

n.description:
Number of images to generate, 1 to 10 as the OpenAI API documents.
The frontend rejects a value outside the range, so a worker never
sees one and needs no range check of its own.

oneOf.description: Delivery mode of the generated images

output_compression.description:
Compression level of jpeg and webp output, 0 to 100 percent as the
OpenAI API documents. The frontend rejects a value outside the range,
so a worker never sees one.

partial_images.description:
Number of partial images to stream before the final image, 0 to 3 as
the OpenAI API documents. The frontend rejects a value outside the
range, so a worker never sees one.

size.description: Image size in WxH format, or "auto"

oneOf.description:
Ordered references of the images to edit, for image-to-image and
`/v1/images/edits`. On the wire one reference is a string and two or
more are an array: see [`ImageReferences`].

extra_args.description: Worker-boundary passthrough. The frontend nests unknown top-level request fields (an OpenAI client's extra_body) under the "media_passthrough" key.

NvImagesResponse.description:
Response for image generation.

Keeps the wire format of the OpenAI `ImagesResponse`, which writes every
absent optional field as null. `nvext` is Dynamo's response extension;
the key is omitted when the worker reports nothing.

oneOf.description: Token usage of the generation, when the model reports it
Image accounting for models without token usage
